ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Fraud Scandal on Social Services Funding
ideas.description: Investigate how the Minnesota fraud scandal has affected social services funding in the state and what measures are being taken to prevent future fraud.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
How will the funding freeze affect social services in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the consequences of the fraud scandal on vulnerable populations and the steps being taken to ensure accountability and prevent future fraud.
